newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Bancorp to acquire Gateway for $20.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Bancorp to acquire Gateway for $20.5 mln.

text.p: Peoples Bancorp Inc said Friday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Gateway Bancorp Inc for about $20.5 million.

Peoples said it will acquire all shares of Gateway common stock for $6.00 each, plus a number of shares of the common stock of Peoples, which will result in an aggregate purchase price of $18.75 per share.

Based on the closing price of the Peoples common stock on April 24, the stockholders of Gateway would receive .40 shares of Peoples Common stock per share of Gateway and the aggregate price of the transaction, exclusive of payment for Gateway stock options, is $20,170,388. The total price for Gateway's stock options is approximately $383,250.
The transaction, is subject to Peoples receipt of permission from federal regulators to enter into a definitive agreement with Gateway.

The definitive agreement is expected to provide the Gateway stockholders with an election to receive all cash, all Peoples common stock or a combination of both, provided, however, that not more than 68 percent of the total price shall be paid in Peoples common stock.
The merger is also subject to approval by the shareholders of Gateway and the appropriate Federal regulators. It is expected the transaction will be consummated in approximately six months.
